name: spleen associated tyrosine kinase
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SYK encodes tyrosine-protein kinase SYK. Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and protein kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to immunodeficiency 82 with systemic inflammation (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
